description: Tag names that legitimately contain a connector word as part of the name itself, so the splitter must not break them apart - even when they appear inside a longer list ('Drum & Bass & UK Garage' -> ['Drum & Bass', 'UK Garage']). Matched case-insensitively, with any amount of whitespace around the connector. Add an entry whenever a real 'X & Y' genre or category name turns up in the data.
